title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
abstract: arXiv:2610.27911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise agents answer questions over workplace records that evolve through team collaboration. As information is shared, corrected, and revised across documents, chats, and figures, multiple versions of the same information accumulate in the workspace. Reliable question answering therefore requires agents to reason over sufficient evidence, resolve cross-source and temporal conflicts, and recognize when the available evidence is insufficient to establish an answer. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce MMEnterprise-Bench, a benchmark comprising 1,613 questions grounded in evolving multimodal records from simulated collaboration projects, covering three categories: Evidence Reasoning, Conflict Resolution, and Unanswerability. We evaluate 10 proprietary and open-source multimodal LLMs and find that even the strongest models struggle when evidence contains cross-source or temporal conflicts or spans multiple images.

translated_title: MMEnterprise-Bench：在动态演化的多模态记录上评估企业智能体
translated_abstract: 企业智能体需要在通过团队协作不断演化的工作记录上回答问题。随着信息在文档、聊天和图表之间被共享、纠正和修订，同一信息的多个版本会在工作空间中不断累积。因此，可靠的问答要求智能体基于充分的证据进行推理、解决跨来源和跨时间的冲突，并识别现有证据是否不足以确立答案。为了系统地评估这些能力，我们提出了MMEnterprise-Bench，这是一个包含1,613个问题的基准，这些问题基于模拟协作项目中不断演化的多模态记录，涵盖三个类别：证据推理、冲突消解和不可回答性。我们评估了10个专有和开源的多模态大语言模型，发现即使是最强的模型，在证据包含跨来源或时间冲突、或跨越多张图像时也会表现不佳。
tldr: 提出了MMEnterprise-Bench，一个基于动态演化多模态企业记录、包含1,613个问题、涵盖证据推理、冲突消解与不可回答性三大类别的基准，用于系统评估企业智能体问答能力，并发现即便最强的多模态大模型在跨来源/时间冲突及多图证据场景下仍难以胜任。
